procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the three pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL -- p2 after ROTATE_90, p3 after ROTATE_270 and p1's FILED stamp block the other way (per-page rotation varies in this county's scan -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/calhoun/). Single-table county: p2 carries the whole crosstab (10 precincts + TOTAL) from U.S. Senate through Chancery 18 Place 1's two rows; p3 = table B over the same 10 precincts + TOTAL carrying Chancery 18 Place 2 and Circuit 3's three Places, then locals. Every in-scope row's cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (19/19).

Shackelford and Michael Watts (Chancery Court 18-Chancery District 18 Place 2's candidates) print at the p3 table's top with no header above them, and each following header box labels the row block ABOVE it -- 'Circuit Court 3-Circuit District 03 Place 1' under Bob Whitwell's row, 'Place 2' under Gray Tollison's, 'Place 3' mid-block between Steven Patrick Jubera and Kent E. Smith. Read as printed, Calhoun pairs Circuit 3 as Place 1 = Bob Whitwell, Place 2 = Gray Tollison, Place 3 = Bart M. Adams + Shirley C. Byers + Steven Patrick Jubera + Kent E.
